properties.name: Sky Meadows State Park (Northern Piedmont)
properties.description: Sky Meadows State Park near Paris and Delaplane in Fauquier County, at the foot of the northern Blue Ridge in Virginia's northern Piedmont. Rolling pasture-and-forest trails (Piedmont, North Ridge, Ambassador Whitehouse) climb from the historic Mount Bleak farmstead to the ridgeline, where a spur connects to the Appalachian Trail. Open-meadow-to-forest hiking with moderate ridge elevation.
properties.bbox_comment: [west, south, east, north] in decimal degrees (WGS84)
properties.origins_comment: Named search origins the frontend picker offers for this region (Phase 2: config-driven — adding/removing an origin is a config edit, not a frontend deploy). key is the wire/UI identifier; lat/lon WGS84.
properties.min_fetch_counts_comment: Per-source raw-fetch floors (a source fetching below its floor aborts the run BEFORE any load/prune — a truncated/partial fetch can't self-wipe). Keys match registry source names (only OSM fetches geometry here; USGS is 3DEP elevation enrichment, which never fetches). NOT live-measured in this config-only lane — set to a deliberately conservative low floor so it catches gross truncation without false-tripping; recalibrate to ~70% of the measured live Overpass baseline on first ingest. Env-overridable via ADVENTURE_FETCH_MIN_OSM.
